# 58th Annual NAMC National Conference (2027)

> The national conference of the National Association of Minority Contractors (NAMC), hosted by the NAMC Wisconsin Chapter. June 28–30, 2027 at the Pfister Hotel, 424 E Wisconsin Ave, Milwaukee, WI 53202. Theme: Powering the Future: Maximizing Community Benefit Through Local Business.

Key facts:
- Dates: Monday, June 28 to Wednesday, June 30, 2027
- Venue: The Pfister Hotel, Milwaukee, Wisconsin. Conference hotel rate $239 per night.
- Registration: Early Bird $400 from January 1 to April 30, 2027; Standard $500 from May 1 to June 17, 2027. Registration includes the Welcome Reception, all plenary sessions and networking events, and the Hall of Fame Awards Gala.
- Keynote speaker: Khia Chukudebelu, Microsoft Cloud Operations + Innovation
- Sponsorship levels from $5,000 to $50,000. Exhibit booths $1,500. Program Journal ads from $750.
- Host: NAMC Wisconsin Chapter, 9300 W. Heather Avenue, Milwaukee. Phone (414) 305-7360. Email timothy@namcwi.org. Chapter site: https://namcwi.org/
